notes.title: Patch Notes - 12.7.2024
notes.notes:
- [b]Fixed:[/b] Iron Maiden and Mannequins no longer follow the chimp indefinitely.
- [b]Improved:[/b] Increased collision detection for the traps.
- [b]Enhanced:[/b] Traps can now be escaped even without flash charges.
- [b]Adjusted:[/b] Extended the flash duration for the chimp before monsters appear.
- [b]Added:[/b] Additional dialogs after day 8.
- [b]Improved:[/b] Less annoying tutorial dialogues.
